baseline_models.focus_anchor: The restrictive exception after the focus verb of objection makes belief in God and received revelation the only stated count against the speakers.
baseline_models.mechanism: The question forces the addressees to expose an inverted valuation: the object of their disapproval is not an injury committed by the speakers but their settled assent to a continuous revelation.

activation_trace.role: Supplies fault-finding and displeasure as the governing relation that the exception interrogates.
Supplies heart-settled assent as the conduct paradoxically treated as blameworthy.
Supplies delivered revelation, present and prior, as the content around which the disputed assent settles.

changed_reading.before: The verse merely asks why the addressees dislike the believers.
changed_reading.after: The verse makes the accusers name settled trust in delivered revelation as their only alleged grievance, thereby putting their standard of blame on trial.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Belief is coordinated with what was sent to the speakers and what was sent earlier.
baseline_models.mechanism: Interior security and assent bind two deliveries across time. The current reception does not cancel the earlier one; the repeated descent and temporal anteriority make faith a continuity-bearing posture.

activation_trace.role: Supplies inward security and reliability as the receiving posture.
Supplies two delivered movements whose shared source joins current and former revelation.
Supplies temporal precedence, turning the second delivery into an earlier link rather than a rival object.

changed_reading.before: Belief is assent to the present message alone.
changed_reading.after: Belief is a secure reception that holds present and prior descents together as one temporally extended trust.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The address names a community by its relation to the Book, but the closing predicate is limited to most of them.
baseline_models.mechanism: Community belonging gathers people around an assembled, obligating corpus; the material image of a ripe date leaving its skin recasts transgression as an exit from that enclosure. The majority quantifier marks extensive breach without erasing the community or making the judgment total.

activation_trace.role: Supplies affiliation and proximity as the social enclosure named by the address.
Supplies assembly of parts as the corpus around which the addressed community is gathered.
Supplies binding determination, making relation to the Book normative rather than merely titular.
Supplies numerical predominance while preserving a remainder outside the predicate.
Supplies a concrete breakout from an enclosing skin as an exploratory model of breached affiliation.

changed_reading.before: People of the Book is a homogeneous label and the closing predicate is a generic denunciation.
changed_reading.after: The address names a community gathered around an obligating corpus, then describes a majority as having broken out of its enclosure while deliberately leaving a non-breaching remainder.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding treatment of religion and prayer as ridicule and aimless activity makes the focus objection an evaluative reversal: purposeful trust is faulted by people who empty worship of serious purpose and whose reason does not restrain that inversion.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the changed model in the focus question about what is being found objectionable.
Supplies derisive valuation, functioning as the opposite standard to the serious assent defended in the focus.
Supplies action without a sound end, showing how a directed religious act is stripped of purpose.
Supplies the absent restraint that would otherwise block the inversion of blame.

structural_cues: 5:57-5:58 immediately precede the focus question and repeat ridicule and play before the judgment that the group does not reason.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ridicule, purposeless activity, and absent rational restraint; I infer that these form the reversed evaluative standard exposed by 5:59. Alternatively, they may identify the disputants without fully causing their objection.

changed_reading.before: The addressees happen to resent the speakers' creed.
changed_reading.after: Their resentment is the next expression of a reversed scale that trivializes directed worship and then treats serious trust as the defect.

context_deltas.mechanism: A spoken claim of belief is carried across an entry and an exit while the concealed interior remains unchanged. The focus claim of belief therefore cannot function as a verbal password; it denotes assent that must penetrate and stabilize the inner person.

activation_trace.role: Anchors belief in inward security and trust rather than in an utterance alone.
Supplies the explicit assent-claim whose adequacy is tested by the surrounding motion and concealment.
Supplies movement into an interior, functioning as a test of what actually accompanies entry.
Supplies movement back outside with the same concealed condition, revealing no inward conversion.
Supplies hidden content as the decisive layer beneath the public belief-claim.

structural_cues: 5:61 orders the claim of belief before entry with unbelief and exit with it, then closes with divine knowledge of what is concealed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a belief-claim, unchanged inward cargo across entry and exit, and concealment; I infer that genuine focus-belief must alter the interior. Alternatively, 5:61 may expose hypocrisy without offering a complete definition of faith.

changed_reading.before: The focus speakers defend the correctness of a confession.
changed_reading.after: They defend an assent that takes up residence within; identical words without interior transition are explicitly shown to be insufficient.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus majority and breakout image acquire a social process: many accelerate into harmful acts while learned authorities fail to stop them. Boundary breach is reproduced by both behavioral momentum and absent institutional restraint.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the model in the focus predicate through the image of material leaving its enclosure.
Anchors the model in the focus majority rather than an undifferentiated whole.
Repeats the numerical predominance and connects it to observable conduct.
Supplies speed rather than stasis, giving the breach self-reinforcing momentum.
Supplies the missing act of checking and restraining, assigning a failed boundary-maintenance function to leaders.

structural_cues: 5:62 makes the many visible in sin, aggression, and illicit consumption; 5:63 asks why religious authorities do not restrain the speech and consumption.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated majority, acceleration into wrongdoing, and failed restraint; I infer a system that reproduces the focus breach. Alternatively, the leadership failure may aggravate rather than generate individual departures.

changed_reading.before: The closing predicate names a static moral class.
changed_reading.after: It diagnoses a majority-scale breakout sustained by rapid practice and by institutions that no longer hold the boundary.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same kind of delivered revelation affirmed in the focus is said to increase many recipients in boundary-exceeding rebellion. Revelation is therefore not only inherited content; its arrival exposes and amplifies the receiver's posture.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the model in the two revelations delivered and trusted in the focus.
Reintroduces delivered revelation as the incoming factor whose effect on many is then specified.
Supplies growth, making reception an amplifying event rather than a neutral encounter.
Supplies overpowering water that exceeds its limit as a material model for the amplified rebellion.
Preserves the split-root image of waterlike overflow, reinforcing boundary excess without collapsing the alternate mapping.

structural_cues: 5:64 states that what was sent to the messenger will increase many in rebellion and unbelief; 5:68 repeats the same relation in another direct address to People of the Book.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies incoming revelation, increase, and limit-breaking overflow; I infer that revelation diagnoses the receiver by amplifying an existing orientation. Alternatively, the increase may describe an occasioned reaction without making diagnostic amplification a general property.

changed_reading.before: What was sent is a stable object that one simply accepts or rejects.
changed_reading.after: Its arrival is an active test: secure receivers join it to prior revelation, while resistant receivers convert the same delivery into intensified excess.

context_deltas.mechanism: Present and prior descents form a relay rather than a static archive. Delivery must reach its audience through responsible transmission and protected messengers, while covenant recipients can filter the relay through desire and messengers themselves pass into history.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the model in revelation delivered to successive recipient positions.
Anchors the relay in temporal precedence and succession.
Supplies the incoming message that must move onward rather than remain possessed.
Supplies successful message-transfer as the relay's required outgoing action.
Supplies protective holding that preserves the human transmission channel.
Supplies an emphatic covenant binding an earlier recipient community to the relay.
Supplies inward inclination as a filter that can reject an unwelcome messenger.
Supplies the passing of time and generations, making messenger succession intrinsic to the relay.
Reactivates temporal precedence around the messengers who passed earlier.

structural_cues: 5:67 equates failure to transmit what descended with failure of the mission.
5:70 divides responses to successive messengers into denial and killing; 5:75 locates the present messenger within a sequence of messengers who passed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies descent, mandated transmission, protection, covenant, desire-filtered rejection, and passing messengers; I connect them as a vulnerable relay. Alternatively, these may be separate duties and historical episodes rather than one transmission mechanism.

changed_reading.before: What was sent before is a settled archive that validates the present creed.
changed_reading.after: It is the earlier reach of a vulnerable relay whose truth must be transmitted, received against desire, and carried beyond each passing messenger.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus majority quantifier becomes a deliberate aperture. Context partitions the same population into a balanced community and many who act badly, so communal address and extensive criticism coexist with a recoverable, norm-oriented remainder.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the model in a shared affiliation broad enough to contain differentiated members.
Anchors the model in a numerical majority that logically leaves a remainder.
Supplies a balanced middle position as the positive identity of part of the addressed population.
Repeats the many on the negative side of an explicit internal partition.

structural_cues: 5:65 makes belief and restored practice conditionally open to People of the Book.
5:66 explicitly contrasts a balanced community among them with many whose works are bad; 5:69 crosses inherited group labels through faith and right action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a focus majority and a later explicit internal partition; I infer that the focus quantifier actively prevents totalization. Alternatively, each quantifier may classify only its immediate scene without a deliberate cross-ayah design.

changed_reading.before: The address condemns People of the Book as a whole, with 'most' functioning as loose rhetoric.
changed_reading.after: The majority judgment is precise social architecture: it criticizes extensively while keeping a balanced and potentially responsive remainder visible.

context_deltas.mechanism: A later counterfactual directly joins belief in God and received revelation to a changed pattern of alliance, then opposes that consequence to the statement that many are transgressors. The focus triad becomes causal: real trust should reorganize proximity and support.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the model in trust and security as a relation capable of ordering other loyalties.
Anchors the model in a breakout from the focus community's normative enclosure.
Supplies the counterfactual assent whose practical consequence is tested.
Supplies received revelation as the second premise of the counterfactual.
Supplies acquired alignment as the action that genuine belief would prevent in this scene.
Supplies loving support and alliance as the practical relation placed under the belief-test.
Repeats the majority immediately after the failed counterfactual.
Repeats breakout as the explanation for why claimed belief does not reorder allegiance.

structural_cues: 5:81 has the exact counterfactual sequence: had they believed in God, the prophet, and what was sent to him, they would not have taken those allies; instead, many are transgressors.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet explicitly supplies premises, negated consequence, and majority predicate; I infer that allegiance is a diagnostic consequence of the focus faith. Alternatively, this alliance is one historically specific consequence and not an exhaustive test of belief.

changed_reading.before: The focus contrasts two confessional positions.
changed_reading.after: It contrasts trust that should reorganize operative loyalties with a majority breakout visible precisely where confession fails to govern alliance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later receptive hearers instantiate a full reception circuit: delivered revelation is understood, recognized, embodied as overflow, converted into a request for enrollment among knowing witnesses, and answered by returning recompense. This gives the focus belief-claim observable stages without reducing it to ethnicity or speech.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the circuit in the focus claim of settled assent.
Anchors the circuit in revelation delivered for reception.
Supplies hearing that reaches understanding and compliance, functioning as the circuit's intake.
Supplies the same delivered input as in the focus, now observed during reception.
Supplies discrimination by a trace or sign, converting heard material into recognized truth.
Supplies easy abundant flow, making recognition visibly exceed inward containment.
Supplies a filled vessel overflowing, giving the receptive response a material threshold.
Supplies enrollment into a register or company as the social conversion of inward recognition.
Supplies testimony grounded in knowledge as the company the hearers seek to join.
Supplies recompense returning to the actors, closing the reception circuit with an answering outcome.

structural_cues: 5:83 sequences hearing what descended, visible tears, recognition of truth, confession, and a request for enrollment among witnesses.
5:84 renews the question of why they should not believe; 5:85 ties their recompense to what they said.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered acts and bodily response; I infer a causal reception circuit from hearing through recognition to witness-enrollment and return. Alternatively, tears, confession, and enrollment may be parallel signs rather than strict causal stages.

changed_reading.before: The focus speakers defend a creed and inherited revelation against another inherited community.
changed_reading.after: They defend a reproducible mode of reception that can arise within the addressed populations: understanding, recognition, embodied overflow, assent, and knowledgeable witness.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links descent, rebellious water-excess, and tear-overflow as one material analogy. It remains anchored in the focus's repeated delivered descent and in two explicit context overflow images, but the connecting hydraulics are reader-supplied; downstream prose should present it as a suggestive receiver-contrast, not as a lexical equivalence.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus repeats revelation's descent, allowing its later opposed overflow effects to recast reception as a test of what kind of vessel receives it.

activation_trace.role: Supplies downward arrival and settling as the incoming movement in the material analogy.
Supplies forceful water exceeding its boundary as the resistant receiver's output.
Preserves the alternate mapped image of waterlike overflow in the resistant response.
Supplies abundant easy flow as the receptive receiver's opposed output.
Supplies a vessel filled beyond capacity, locating receptive overflow in tears.

changed_reading.before: Revelation is content that receivers either accept or reject.
changed_reading.after: Revelation behaves, exploratorily, like an incoming load that reveals its vessel by what overflows: boundary-breaking rebellion in one case and recognition-filled tears in another.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads the focus title People of the Book against a later request to be written into the witness company, shifting from inherited corpus-affiliation to active enrollment. It remains anchored in the repeated writing root and the focus social address, but the semantic loop crosses nominal and verbal uses; downstream prose should mark it as a possible reconfiguration of belonging rather than a replacement definition.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins a people to the Book, while a later receptive group asks to be entered in writing among witnesses.

activation_trace.role: Supplies inherited or communal affiliation as the initial mode of belonging.
Activates the form-distant possibility that relation to the Book also evokes being entered into a named company.
Supplies explicit enrollment, turning recognized truth into a request for newly recorded belonging.
Supplies a company defined by present, seeing witness as the destination of enrollment.

changed_reading.before: People of the Book names a fixed inherited community confronting a new believing group.
changed_reading.after: Book-belonging may also be dynamically rewritten: receptive outsiders to the focus claim can ask to be enrolled into a community constituted by knowledgeable witness.

strongest_changes: The focus objection becomes an exposure of reversed valuation, not merely a report of intergroup dislike.
Belief moves from verbal confession to inward transition with practical consequences for allegiance.
Received revelation becomes both a vulnerable transgenerational relay and a diagnostic amplifier of the receiver.
The majority quantifier preserves a live internal remainder that later appears as balanced and receptive communities.
The late hearing-recognition-tears-enrollment sequence supplies an embodied model of the focus's claimed reception.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly reuses the focus cluster of belief, descent, Book, majority, and breakout in opposed reception scenes. That repetition supports multiple coexisting mechanisms rather than one verdict: speech can conceal or disclose, descent can intensify excess or recognition, and communal affiliation can be breached, preserved, or newly entered.
remaining_uncertainties: The exact syntactic attachment of the final majority predicate in 5:59 affects whether it is itself part of the stated grievance or the speaker's explanatory countercharge.
The ripe-date shell model for transgression and the hydraulic comparison across rebellion and tears are materially vivid but deliberately exploratory.
The allegiance counterfactual establishes a strong consequence of belief in this context, but may not define every manifestation of belief.
